source.title: Reinstatement cannot rest on unsupported claims alone.
source.description:
In M/s Rifilis Engineering Pvt. Ltd. v. Arjun Gupta, the Supreme Court held that an employee seeking reinstatement must produce reliable evidence to justify unauthorised absence or prove an attempt to rejoin. The Court therefore set aside the order granting reinstatement and back wages.

In labour disputes, the burden of proof matters. Oral assertions without supporting evidence may not be enough.

{Unauthorised absence, reinstatement, back wages, burden of proof, Supreme Court labour law}
